hotels.description: Set between the Indian Ocean and the wilderness of Yala National Park, Hilton Yala Resort delivers an immersive safari-style escape in one of Sri Lanka’s most extraordinary natural settings. The resort is thoughtfully woven into the landscape, surrounded by lush greenery and coastal dunes, creating a rare sense of seclusion and connection to nature. At the heart of the resort is its spectacular 58-metre outdoor pool. Built around natural rock formations and native Palu trees, the pool has been designed to resemble a natural water body, blending seamlessly into the surrounding environment. Expansive sun decks, serene lounge spaces and uninterrupted jungle views create an atmosphere that feels both luxurious and tranquil. Unwind at the award-winning eforea Spa, enjoy sophisticated dining across three distinct restaurants and bars, or take part in curated experiences including game drives, bush walks and nature excursions. Combining contemporary luxury with sustainable design, Hilton Yala Resort offers a uniquely elevated wilderness retreat.
